title: Proposed changes with tool quotes
description: schema/patch-set.schema.json for a job with output.tool_citations: a change may also cite a quote of what a tool returned in the run. Everything else is the same. The rules beyond shape are checked by src/output-check/pr.ts.

path.description: The page's path in its repository.

reason.description: One or two sentences: why the page needs no change, or what the patch corrects.

patch.description: A unified diff of this page only, against the given text. Only with decision patch.

changes.description: Every removed and added line of the patch, grouped by the evidence that makes the change true. Only with decision patch.

removed.description: Lines this change removes, exactly as in the page.

added.description: Lines this change adds, exactly as in the patch.

why.description: What the evidence shows, in one sentence.

citation.description: A primary source: a line of a file at a commit, or a commit; or a quote of what a tool returned in the run: an object with tool and quote.

toolQuote.description: A quote of what one of the job's tools returned in the run, word for word (whitespace aside), at least 6 characters.
